Subject: VPC pricing and support options for pilot

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo — the team was impressed with the latency and the KV cache improvements. We're ready to move forward with a small production pilot but need clarity on a few commercial items before we send a purchase order:

- SKU model: we need a short proposal that shows a node-based SKU vs. a seat-based SKU for 3 environments (dev/stage/prod) and expected monthly costs at 8k/20k/50k tokens per day.
- Platform fee: Clearwave accounting wants to understand whether the platform fee is charged upfront, amortized monthly, or capitalized. We prefer amortization over 36 months but need Redwood's flexibility.
- Support tiers: we need a Premium support option that includes a named SME + on-call pager during our pilot window. Pricing and any one-time onboarding credits?
- Discounts/credits: as a healthcare customer with expected expansion next year, can you provide pilot discounts and any implementation credits we can use against the SOW?

I've attached our requirements doc (Clearwave_Reqs_20261120.pdf). Can you send a version of the SKU matrix and a draft SOW we can review with procurement/legal?

Asha

Hi Asha — thanks for the clear list. I've put together a concise options table and a draft SOW for review (attached: Redwood_vpc_sku_matrix.xlsx, SOW-draft-v1.docx). Summary below; full details in the spreadsheet.

Quick summary of options (high level):
- Node-based (recommended for predictable throughput): pricing shown per active inference node (n1/n2/n3) with optional burst nodes. Example pilot: 4 n1 nodes (dev/stage/prod split) = $28k/month before discounts.
- Seat-based (developer seats + metered tokens): cheaper for light, sporadic usage but higher tail-costs if growth spikes.

Platform fee approaches:
- Upfront annual platform fee (standard): $120k/year.
- Amortized monthly (customer request): we can amortize over 36 months for contract purposes — this treats the platform fee as a 36-month amortized service charge for your internal budgeting. For the pilot, we can propose amortization but require a minimum 12-month commitment or prepay agreement to qualify for the amortized schedule.

Support tiers (descriptions in spreadsheet):
- Standard: email SLAs, business-hours support
- Premium: named SME, 24x5 on-call, monthly Tech Reviews ($25k/year)
- Enterprise: 24x7 on-call, priority routing, quarterly on-site reviews ($75k/year)

Pilot concession proposal (pilot-specific):
- 25% pilot discount on node/service charges for the first 3 months (applied to usage only).
- One-time implementation credit: $30k off the SOW (applies to initial onboarding tasks).
- Senior Support add-on: offer Premium support for $0 (waived for first 90 days) to cover the named SME requirement.

If that aligns, I can circulate an internal approval note and lock the SOW with those line items — otherwise propose your changes and we'll iterate.

Attachments: Redwood_vpc_sku_matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), SOW-draft-v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Best,
Jonas Weber

Hi Asha — thanks for the patience while I ran this internally. Final commercial we can extend for the pilot: 

1) SKU & pricing: attached is the final SKU matrix (Redwood_vpc_sku_matrix.xlsx). For your pilot footprint (est. 8k / 20k / 50k tokens/day) the recommended node mix is 2 n1 (dev), 3 n1 (stage), 6 n2 (prod burst-enabled) — estimated $22,400/month pre-discount.

2) Platform fee: we will allow amortization over 36 months for accounting purposes under the following conditions: a) 12-month minimum contract term, b) month-1 prepayment of the amortized schedule, c) finance reserves the right to reclassify on renewal. Amortized equivalent for pilot (annualized fee $120k) = $3,333/month on a 36-month schedule (will appear as a recurring line on the SOW).

3) Pilot concessions:
- Usage discount: 25% off usage/compute for the first 3 months (capped at $75k total concession).
- Implementation credit: $30k one-time credit applied to the SOW professional services line items.
- Support: Premium support waived for first 90 days (named SME + 24x5 on-call included). After 90 days, Premium converts to the paid $25k/year line item unless you elect Enterprise.

4) SLA & onboarding: 99.9% service availability target for production nodes; onboarding runbook and handoff included in SOW. We'll schedule a kickoff within 5 business days of SOW signature.

Next steps:
- I've attached the final SOW draft and SKU matrix. Please confirm you accept the commercial terms and we will issue a DocuSign-ready SOW (link shared once you confirm).
- Legal: if you need an addendum on amortization language for your accounting team, let me know and we can loop in our counsel.
